packageMerge.method: Parse the two frozen NDJSON journals. For each journal select only files with moduleEnd; sum the counts field of those terminal events. Assert original and resume completed-file sets are disjoint; union them. Discard case results from any file without moduleEnd in that attempt, including the original partial emit-llvm.test.ts (completed in resume). The interrupted resume has no final JSON; use its 578 moduleEnd events, not a nonexistent whole-run summary. Recovery runs stay separate. No complete NDJSON line was omitted.
